sentences.text: Learned APP waives service of notice of Rule on behalf of respondent- State.
2. By way of present petition, the petitioner has prayed to release him on 90 days of long parole leave to provide financial assistance to his family.
3. This Court has gone through the jail record of the petitioner-convict.
It appears that the petition has been convicted for the offences punishable under sections 302, 498A of IPC and has been sentenced for life imprisonment along with fine of Rs. 2,200/-.
He has undergone sentence of about eighteen years and five NEUTRAL CITATION R/SCR.A/6149/2024 ORDER DATED: 31/05/2024 undefined months.
The applicant-convict was lastly released in the month of November 2023 on furlough leave and August- September, 2023 on parole leave.
Whenever the petitioner-convict was released on parole leave, he had surrendered on time.
His jail record is found to be good.
